about: Dates Metro may restrict bikes on trains (WMATA, Bikes on Metro Rail: 'Metro reserves the right to restrict bicycle access during special events or high passenger volume'; the owner, 2026-10-12: inaugurations, the 4th of July, Cherry Blossom peak bloom). The transit options flag bike-on-Metro on these dates and still show it (core.transit.bike_blackout). Add a date by hand as {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "why": "..."}; recurring dates are MM-DD.
